messages:
Aisha (partnerships): quick thread 1 1 need to lock down the marketplace bundle + committed spend renewal velocity play for the Q2 joint announcement. want owners, timing, and one-liner customer-facing rules.
Marco (marketplace-sales): proposal: create a "bundle-slate" public SKU that maps to private-offer tiers for commit (6/12/24mo). private offers will give instant off-invoice discount + an attached HW rebate code processed by partner.
Priya (legal): ok but two flags: marketplaces often block private-offer stacking with marketplace coupons; we must call out non-stackability. also need clear definitions for "activation" and "renewal window".
Ken (hw-partner): we can supply rebate codes in batches. prefer codes issued to resellers; we'll accept customer-directed credit if required. propose code expiry = 180 days after issuance.
Riley (field-ops): ops constraints: we need a testing slot with Ken's team by Mar 28 and final runbook by Apr 4 to support the Apr 15 announce.
Marco (marketplace-sales): I'll draft SKU matrix + example private-offer payloads for each tier. will include columns: public_sku, private_offer_id, list_price, discount_pct, min_commit, renewal_uplift.
Aisha (partnerships): good. add a column for "credit_recipient" (reseller|customer) and "credit_workflow" (immediate|reconcile).
Priya (legal): add auditability clause. small snippet: "Credits are subject to verification. Partner will reconcile activation events and issue credits to the designated recipient within 120 days; Redwood retains right to audit redemption records." (will formalize).
Ken (hw-partner): activation event exists on our portal. we'll emit webhook POST to Redwood endpoint. sample payload:
```
POST /v1/partner/events HTTP/1.1
Host: api.hwco.com
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "event": "device.activated",
  "serial": "HW-000123",
  "customer_id": "cust-789",
  "activated_at": "2026-03-20T09:24:00Z"
}
```
Aisha (partnerships): Marco, marketplaces vary in private-offer approval time. build two paths: fast-path (pre-approved template for top-5 resellers) and backlog-path (standard private-offer with 48-72h approval).
Marco (marketplace-sales): noted. will tag top resellers in the sheet and create a template bundle for them.
Riley (field-ops): ops note: we need to validate promo landing pages for SKU parity and ensure CTA links include private-offer redemption instructions.
Priya (legal): renewal mechanics: how do we treat partial consumption? recommend: pro-rated conversion credit only if customer renews within 60 days of term end and reaches 70% of committed consumption. will add language.
Ken (hw-partner): can support telemetry to confirm consumption thresholds for appliances. will need a signed data-sharing addendum.
Aisha (partnerships): analytics: want one metric for partner-sourced renewal lift: "bundle-renewal-conversion-rate" (renewals that convert to >=12mo after promo). Marco, can you wire a dashboard?
Marco (marketplace-sales): yes. will put an initial chart in console and share link in this thread.
announce-bot: draft-announcement: marketplace-bundle + hw-rebate pilot (target: Apr 15) (status: draft)
Riley (field-ops): action items recap: Marco -> SKU matrix + templates (by Mar 22). Priya -> legal snippets & audit addendum (by Mar 24). Ken -> confirm code issuance cadence + webhook docs (by Mar 21). Aisha -> partner comms + announce draft (by Mar 28). Ops -> integration test Mar 28-Apr 1.
Aisha (partnerships): risks: 1) marketplace approval delays 2) mis-specified SKUs causing mismatch in billing 3) late HW code issuance. contingency: keep a "hold" SKU that maps to fallback public price and manual crediting.
Marco (marketplace-sales): I'll add fallback logic in the spreadsheet and mark manual-credit cases.
Priya (legal): will prepare a 2-paragraph boilerplate for offers and a short audit addendum. sharing draft here when ready.
Ken (hw-partner): confirming code batch size of 500 for pilot. will send sample webhook schema by EOD.
Riley (field-ops): scheduling tests now. putting timeblocks on calendar and creating runbook PR.
Aisha (partnerships): thanks all 1 keep updates in this thread and well converge next Tue sync at 9am PT if needed.
